scope: A5-1 through A5-7 source/evidence reconciliation and isolated auxiliary EWDAP/transport tests. No production, device, desktop, service or model mutations.

ownership.thisWorkline: p8-easywork audit and synthetic security/transport boundaries
ownership.otherWorkline: Existing EasyWork dual-platform real DEV work owns the main checkout WIP, full history/search/plan UI and its acceptance.easywork install
ownership.disposition: No WIP copied; production files deliberately unchanged because ownership overlaps. Current external source/environment fingerprints have not been adopted.

groups.name: Registered providers and complete target identity
interactions: Select Codex or EasyWork by registered provider ID, never display name
Keep authority/subject/device/workspace/runtime/thread distinct; route edits preserve identity
Reject an unknown wire method before opening a transport; preserve immutable operation intent
groups.currentSourceAssessment: Provider dispatch, target conversion and narrow adapter methods are present. New management/notification capabilities remain with their existing owners; no arbitrary shell or IPC exposure is added.
groups.realGate: On each leased environment switch two similar targets; verify original Codex owner and EasyWork runtime independently, with isolated drafts/receipts/events and zero wrong-target writes.
iosAndroidSourceComparison: iOS uses AgentClient while Android registers AgentReads/AgentCommands; both map EasyWork behind the adapter. Android explicitly rejects Codex staged creation/active-open APIs for EasyWork and uses its direct thread/create path.
Current iOS adapter declares notification operations absent from this Android adapter. That P9 dependency is recorded, not implemented or accepted by P8.

groups.name: Discovery, pairing, certificate and device binding
interactions: Bonjour or saved route selection, QR or 16-character connection code, original Desktop confirmation
Reject stale offers, altered certificate/public key/binding, and untrusted scanned relay origin
Authenticated runtime context may add LAN candidates without replacing target identity
groups.currentSourceAssessment: Current form uses EWDAP code/QR without phone login. Paired descriptor checks and pinned private LAN transport are present. Legacy pairing remains a separate compatibility path; source presence does not prove physical camera or certificate refusal.
groups.realGate: Physical camera and manual code, fresh discovery and saved route; Desktop approves/rejects the exact device. Exercise real wrong certificate/public key/expiry without repointing any existing user connection.
iosAndroidSourceComparison: iOS discovery/camera/form and Android NSD/CameraX/Compose have separate native implementations. Shared source semantics include 16-character EWDAP code, Desktop confirmation and full-target/public-key checks; native form/camera/permission parity is unverified here.

groups.name: Encrypted LAN and relay, handshake and recovery
interactions: Automatic prefers LAN; LAN-only and relay-only keep explicit policy
Key confirmation precedes protocol processing; encrypted header, request ID and target are authenticated
A lost write reply switches path and queries original operation receipt; only reads retry with unchanged request
groups.currentSourceAssessment: Current request recovery checks receipt operationId/method/requestHash/target and never retries the write. Synthetic transport injection exercises this production path; it does not exercise real WSS, relay authentication, restart or public routing.
groups.realGate: Both actual paths plus automatic failover on one frozen app/runtime candidate; retain original thread/run/operation IDs and independently count Desktop inputs before/after every failure and restart.
iosAndroidSourceComparison: iOS Foundation and Android OkHttp are distinct transports. Both expose a 32 MiB receive limit; Android also bounds queued frames/count. The current Android session is exercised with synthetic encrypted peers, not with iOS/native transport evidence.

groups.name: Workspace, history, models, plan and event presentation
interactions: Existing project/thread directory, paging, full-history search and revisit
Separate plan card/steps, compaction state, actual owner settings and capability-driven speed
Gap/epoch recovery, cached reading and runtime health shown separately
groups.currentSourceAssessment: Adapter maps workspace/history/models/plans and shared authoritative deltas. The active EasyWork workline owns full-history/search/plan-card corrections. Its WIP is absent from this candidate; no UI fix or current native pass is inferred.
groups.realGate: Compare current native screens with iOS for complete history/search/plan/settings and actual runtime; inspect every applicable screenshot and anchor/state transition. Await owned corrections rather than duplicating them.
iosAndroidSourceComparison: Both adapters consume authoritative thread/sync but platform history projection/UI remain distinct. Current Android candidate omits the other EasyWork workline full-history/search/plan-card WIP; neither its later fixes nor its proofs are adopted.

groups.name: Create, reply, queue, guidance, stop, approvals and resources
interactions: Create project/no-project thread, first input and attachment-only input; receive exact original receipt
Native client queue owns execution; steer/stop/plan/approval/question bind original Run and request
Upload/download real bytes with digest, scope and independent random attachment-content check
groups.currentSourceAssessment: Named operations, native queue evidence and resource methods are present. Current auxiliary recovery checks only the session boundary. File UI, migration, notifications, full history and plan-card work remain with their owners.
groups.realGate: Real model plus independent Desktop canonical input/run count for each creation/queue/control/approval/question/resource case on both paths; unknown old operations stay read-only.
iosAndroidSourceComparison: Both map named EasyWork operations and native client queue receipts; Android explicitly rejects Codex staged creation/upload and active-open methods. Direct new-thread creation is a separate supported path whose actual capabilities and receipt must be checked.
Android and iOS resource/approval/question UI are separately implemented; current production-input fingerprints cannot be inferred from shared wire method names.

groups.name: Desktop-confirmed EWDAP grant, DPoP, refresh and revocation
interactions: Phone claims anonymously; signed-in original Desktop confirms device and verification code
ECDH-ES/A256GCM delivers device grant; system P-256 DPoP binds URL/method/token/body/key
Persist claim/refresh/revoke intent before network I/O; exact-binding revocation and no legacy-token downgrade
Migration conveys descriptive provider data only; fresh local keys and explicit re-pairing precede new authorization
groups.currentSourceAssessment: Scoped grants, DPoP, encrypted delivery, persisted refresh and revocation are present. OS-backed DPoP key creation is deliberately outside host-JVM evidence. Legacy phone OIDC is compatibility code, not the EWDAP gate or a requirement to sign in on phone.
groups.realGate: Each target OS verifies actual Keystore/Keychain, Desktop confirmation/rejection, replay/key/body/binding refusals, real token expiry and new-process refresh, exact grant revoke. Public Desktop OIDC and deployed cross-network relay are separate gates.
iosAndroidSourceComparison: iOS uses CryptoKit/SecKey/Keychain while Android uses BouncyCastle plus AndroidKeyStore. Android host-JVM JWE proof does not exercise either secure-store implementation or DPoP key lifetime.
Both sources keep phone EWDAP anonymous and Desktop account authorization distinct; compatibility phone OIDC code is not evidence of EWDAP public deployment.

groups.name: API26/API37/physical matrix, recovery and Codex regression
interactions: API26, API37 and leased physical phone each exercise LAN/relay plus app/desktop restart and target switch
Inspect original screenshots, exact bundle and source/package/runner/environment fingerprints
Independent Codex regression; preserve prior failure and never replay sealed unknown input
groups.currentSourceAssessment: Only current auxiliary JVM evidence is produced here. No device lease was granted and no device or original Desktop/model action was performed. Every group remains unsealed for this current candidate.
groups.realGate: Integrator supplies exact device/package/time lease, compatible isolated Electron/relay build and unique new task intents; freeze all evidence before claiming scoped current or matched-reuse passes.
iosAndroidSourceComparison: Old API26/API37/Xiaomi and iOS proofs retain their original source/environment hashes. No leased current device proof or whole native+Desktop fingerprint match is available to this workline.
